source_status: 本地确定性评估样本，来源于智能问数详细设计和现有 MVP 样例结果；不是实时 MySQL 查询结果。

fixtures.question: 上个月总销售额多少
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders WHERE date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01' LIMIT 100

fixtures.question: 各渠道销售额排行
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT channel, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC LIMIT 100

fixtures.question: 手机品类卖得最好的 5 个品牌
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT brand, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_order_details WHERE category = '手机' GROUP BY brand ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC LIMIT 5

fixtures.question: 华东区金卡用户买了多少钱
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders WHERE region = '华东' AND customer_tier = '金卡' LIMIT 100

fixtures.question: 今年每个月销售额趋势
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT MONTH(date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders WHERE date >= '2026-01-01' AND date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(date) ORDER BY MONTH(date) LIMIT 100

fixtures.question: 哪个支付方式用的人最多
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM wide_orders GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) DESC LIMIT 1

fixtures.question: 退款率最高的品类是哪些
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT category, SUM(CASE WHEN is_refunded = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(order_id) AS refund_rate FROM wide_order_details GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN is_refunded = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(order_id) DESC LIMIT 5

fixtures.question: 周末和工作日哪个卖得多
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) IN (1, 7) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders GROUP BY CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) IN (1, 7) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END LIMIT 100
